subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go works via direct infer but fails in embedded agent runtime with session takeover

question: Is the proof on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89039 sufficient to treat it as the canonical fix path for this OpenCode Go embedded-runtime takeover report, or should maintainers require separate live `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` validation first?
rationale: The issue is concrete and maps to live source, but the exact provider/runtime timing was not reproduced here and the current fix candidate is a broad unmerged session-takeover PR rather than a provider-specific merged fix.

options.title: Review PR then validate OpenCode Go
options.body: Treat the open recovery PR as the likely fix path, but keep this issue open until a maintainer or contributor proves direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and tool-call behavior for `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

options.title: Split provider follow-up now
options.body: Keep the generic recovery PR separate and open a narrower OpenCode Go embedded-runtime validation/fix path before deciding this issue is covered.

options.title: Defer until after merge
options.body: Do no new work on this issue until the recovery PR lands, then re-test and close or narrow based on the post-merge result.

recommendation.title: Review PR then validate OpenCode Go
recommendation.body: Treat the open recovery PR as the likely fix path, but keep this issue open until a maintainer or contributor proves direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and tool-call behavior for `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source history and provider/runtime work make this the best available routing owner for deciding proof sufficiency across session-lock and OpenCode Go behavior.
